payload.title: Home page: rank References by human rating, then Cyclotron confidence
payload.description: src/papyrus_content/projection/standard/home_page_blocks.py and home_page/export.py. Add one shared ordering: 5, 4 and 3 stars, then unrated by Cyclotron confidence, then 2 and 1 stars; ties newest, then key. Use it for the confident and recommended selections and the new bucketed sort. Add starRating to the fields home-page reads, without printing it. _data/home-page/references.json may be readable publicly, so carry the order as a rank or a pre-sorted list if that file is public, and check that first; the EXCLUDED_REFERENCE_FIELDS guard must keep passing. Add starRating to the fields that make homePageTrigger run (docs/home-page.md), so rating a Reference updates the pages through the existing debounce and digest.
